name: Tissue-specific SNR (and other tissue-specific metrics)
summary: Computes tissue- and b-shell-specific SNR and diffusion metric statistics from a DWI and T1w, using MRtrix3 tensor and 5-tissue-type segmentation and DIPY/wma_pyTools.
description: Fits a diffusion (and kurtosis) tensor with MRtrix3 inside an FSL bet mask, derives FA, MD, AD, RD and shape maps, builds a five-tissue-type segmentation from the T1w with 5ttgen fsl, resamples it to the DWI grid and reports SNR and other metrics per tissue (cortical GM, subcortical GM, WM, CSF) and per b-shell. Use it as a DWI quality-control step. The T1w and DWI must be aligned; the README is an unfilled template.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image used to build the 5-tissue-type segmentation.
Preprocessed DWI with bvecs and bvals; multi-shell data give per-shell statistics.

outputs.description: An SNR (and other metric report) with tissue & b-shell specific measurements.
